Every tree-derived field below (shard inventory, delink coverage, manifest set, promoted siblings, queue row, header contents) was re-derived against THIS commit. ROM-derived fields were cut from extracted/ and are independent of it.
identity_evidence: ROM RTTI, not coined. The ov006 image bytes at 0x0213ce60 are 31 32 64 53 63 4d 67 4c 75 69 67 69 5f 63 00 = the NUL-terminated string "12dScMgLuigi_c", read from extracted/overlays/overlay_0006.bin at file offset 0x7cfa0 (0x0213ce60 - 0x020bfec0). The __si_class_type_info record at 0x0213ce54 points its +0x04 name word at that string, and config/arm9/overlays/ov006/symbols.txt names 0x0213ce60 _ZTS12dScMgLuigi_c. No part of the class name is invented.
module_base_evidence: extracted/dsd/arm9_overlays/overlays.yaml, overlay id 6: base_address 34340544 = 0x020bfec0, code_size 525344 = 0x80420, bss_size 11712 = 0x2dc0. NOT 0x020c0000.

typeinfo.kind_vtable: 0x0209a764 = __si_class_type_info's vtable (arm9). The sibling value 0x0209a774 marks __class_type_info (no base); fBase_c carries that one, which is how the ancestor walk terminates.

base_evidence: The __si_class_type_info record at ov006 0x0213ce54 reads 64 a7 09 02 | 60 ce 13 02 | 6c bf 0b 02, so its +0x08 base word is 0x020bbf6c. Read at that address IN ov004 (extracted/overlays/overlay_0004.bin, base 0x020ad660, file offset 0xe90c) the three words are 0x0209a764, 0x020bbf84, 0x020914d4, and 0x020bbf84 holds the NUL-terminated string "11dScMgBase_c". config/arm9/overlays/ov004/symbols.txt line 579 independently names 0x020bbf6c _ZTI11dScMgBase_c. Four overlays (0, 2, 4, 7) overlap address 0x020bbf6c; only ov004's bytes there form a type_info record and only ov004's symbols.txt names it, so the module is unambiguous. Vtable length is NOT the evidence: dScMgLuigi_c and dScMgBase_c both have 36 slots, which is corroboration only.
ancestor_chain_evidence: Walked +0x08 from record to record in extracted/arm9_dec.bin (base 0x02004000). Names read from each record's +0x04 pointer: 8dScene_c, 7dBase_c, 7fBase_c. fBase_c's kind word is 0x0209a774 rather than 0x0209a764, i.e. __class_type_info, so the chain terminates there rather than at whatever follows it in memory.

vtable.extent_evidence: Read from extracted/overlays/overlay_0006.bin. 0x0213cf08 = 0x00000000 (offset-to-top), 0x0213cf0c = 0x0213ce54 (= _ZTI12dScMgLuigi_c), then 36 consecutive relocated code pointers from slot 0 at 0x0213cf10 through slot 35 at 0x0213cf9c. The exclusive end 0x0213cfa0 is NOT a slot: its bytes are 2f 47 4d 2f 64 32 5f 64 ... = the ASCII string "/MG/d_2d_mg_bg_luigi1_ncg.bin\0", and dsd gives it its own symbol data_ov006_0213cfa0. tools/rtti_vtables.py --own dScMgLuigi_c independently reports 36 slots against a 36-slot base. No trailing null slot was truncated here, because the table is followed by string data rather than by zeros.

complete_slots.note: Address 0x020ad660 is the FIRST byte of ov002, ov004 and ov007 alike (all three share base_address 0x020ad660), and each defines a different function there: func_ov002_020ad660 (0x1d8), _ZN11dScMgBase_c9Virtual8CEv (0x14) and func_ov007_020ad660 (0x410). ov004 is the applicable resident: the direct base's RTTI lives in ov004 and 21 of the other 22 inherited slots resolve into ov004, whose symbols.txt is the only one naming this target as a dScMgBase_c member.

adds_no_new_virtuals: dScMgBase_c also has 36 slots (tools/rtti_vtables.py --own reports 'dScMgLuigi_c : dScMgBase_c 36 slots (base 36)'), so dScMgLuigi_c declares no new virtual function; all 7 own entries override inherited slots. Slot 18 is OnYoshiTryEat, inherited from dScMgBase_c, whose own entry is 0x020b2994.
destructor_order: D1 at 0x020efc0c (0x24 bytes) precedes D0 at 0x020efc30 (0x38 bytes). Both store the vptr 0x0213cf10 at offset 0 and then BL ov004 0x020b29c0 (dScMgBase_c D2). D0 additionally loads the heap pointer from arm9 bss data_020a0eac and calls arm9 0x0203c1e8 _ZN6Memory10DeallocateEPvP4Heap. No dScMgLuigi_c D2 symbol exists.

text_span.boundary_confidence: high on the right, medium on the left
text_span.right_boundary_evidence: The class's last function is dScMgLuigi_c_classInit at 0x020f3800 (0x34 bytes), ending exactly at 0x020f3834, where _ZN13dScMgMemory_cD1Ev begins. 0x020f3834 is also the start of the ALREADY PROMOTED delink unit src/minigames/d_s_mg_memory.cpp, whose manifest config/tu_manifest.d/ov006/dScMgMemory_c.json declares sections .text 0x020f3834..0x020f5564. A named other class's destructor plus a landed single-span TU is a hard boundary, not an inference.
text_span.left_boundary_evidence: The function immediately below, func_ov006_020efc08, is 4 bytes and its only word is 0xe12fff1e = 'bx lr' - an empty function. It is its own delink unit src/func_ov006_020efc08.c. Below IT is dScMgJump2_c_classInit at 0x020efaf0. Nothing in the ROM attributes the stub to either neighbour, so it is left OUT of this class's span. If a byte gate later demands it, it is the only candidate to move.
text_span.self_containment_evidence: Proven twice, independently. (1) Relocations: config/arm9/overlays/ov006/relocs.txt has 13518 rows, of which 6938 carry module:overlay(6). Filtering on that spelling, exactly 70 accepted rows point into [0x020efc0c,0x020f3834); 39 originate inside the span and 31 outside, and ALL 31 outside ones are kind:load from this class's own data cluster - 7 from vtable slots, 23 from PMF records, 1 from g_profile_MG_LUIGI. Zero kind:arm_call rows enter the span from elsewhere in ov006. (2) Decoding: every BL/BLX word in every ov006 function body was decoded; 0 target the span from outside it, and 0 leave the span for another ov006 function. The 37 intra-class calls found by decoding are the SAME 37 found by relocation, set for set. Sanity check on the filter, per roles/scout.md: scanning the other modules' relocs.txt for this address range yields 164 address-overlapping rows, of which the module filter REJECTS 163 - an unfiltered scan would have invented 163 phantom callers.

shard_inventory.pragma_note: MEASURED 7 pragma-bearing shards on base 6d4c9b33; the queue row still says pragma:6, because src/func_ov006_020f2790.cpp arrived after the row was generated. opt_strength_reduction and opt_common_subs are FILE-GLOBAL in mwccarm, so folding these seven into one TU applies each pragma to every member below it in the merged file. data_ownership.data_cluster_evidence: Lower bound: dScMgJump2_c's _ZTV is at 0x0213ccfc and has 36 slots (tools/rtti_vtables.py --own dScMgJump2_c: 'dScMgJump2_c : dScMgD3DBase_c 36 slots (base 36)'), so it ends at 0x0213ccfc + 0x90 = 0x0213cd8c, which is exactly this class's first PMF record. Beware: naively walking that table until a non-code word overruns by one slot, because the first PMF record's leading word is itself a code pointer. Upper bound: the resource path at 0x0213cfa0 is loaded by THIS class (relocation from:0x020f37c0 kind:load to:0x0213cfa0 module:overlay(6); 0x020f37c0 lies inside InitResources, 0x020f3460..0x020f3800). The next three data symbols 0x0213cfc0/0x0213cfc8/0x0213cfd0 are loaded from 0x02131474/0x021314c4/0x0213146c, all inside __sinit_ov006_021311c8, which dScMgMemory_c's manifest claims as its own static initializer. So the boundary is 0x0213cfc0.

It holds the string "/MG/d_2d_mg_bg_luigi1_ncg.bin" and the only reference to it is from:0x020f37c0, inside _ZN12dScMgLuigi_c13InitResourcesEv. dScMgMemory_c's data cluster actually begins at 0x0213cfc0. irq_callback.constraint: Installed as IRQ 2's handler by arm9 _ZN3IRQ13SetIRQHandlerEjPFvvE, whose second parameter mangles as PFvvE = void(*)(). This function is taken as a PLAIN function pointer and cannot become a non-static dScMgLuigi_c member. Leave it a free function, or make it a static member. This is the one member of the 50 whose form the ROM constrains outright.

non_virtual_note: The 50 functions below are every function in the span that is neither a vtable target nor the factory. Measured on base 6d4c9b33: 23 are reached only through the class's own PMF records with a zero this-adjustment, 26 are called directly and only from inside this class, and 1 is the IRQ handler above. Every caller address was confirmed twice - once from module-filtered relocations and once by decoding every BL in ov006 .text - and the two sets are identical. This proves TU membership and dispatch shape. It does NOT prove original identifiers, nor member-versus-file-local linkage.

factory.evidence: The profile record at 0x0213ce0c is {0x020f3800, 0x016e, 0x016e}; its first word is the factory.

size_evidence: dScMgLuigi_c_classInit at 0x020f3800 does: ldr r0,[pc,#0x20] -> literal at 0x020f382c = 0x0000545c; bl 0x02043444 (_ZN7fBase_cnwEj, fBase_c::operator new); movs r4,r0; beq +2; bl 0x020b2adc (ov004 dScMgBase_c C2); ldr r0,[pc,#0x10] -> literal at 0x020f3830 = 0x0213cf10; str r0,[r4]. So: allocate 0x545c, run the BASE constructor, then store the vptr inline. There is no dScMgLuigi_c constructor symbol - construction is the base C2 plus a vptr store emitted into the factory. Corroboration: a sweep of all 30 ov006 *_classInit allocation literals puts this one at 0x545c, and include/dScMgLuigi_c.h already carries a static assert that sizeof(dScMgLuigi_c) == 0x545c.
derived_storage_boundary_evidence: func_ov006_020f2ec0, the Luigi-only initializer called with the unadjusted object from 0x020f3348 and 0x020f3730, begins its 16-iteration 0x14-stride record loop at exactly +0x4660 (0x020f2f28: add r2,r3,#0x4000 / str ip,[r2,#0x660]), and the base constructor's highest observed writes are at +0x4658 and +0x465e. Two independent paths converge on +0x4660. This is an INFERENCE, not a proof: RTTI does not encode sizeof(dScMgBase_c). The only hard bound available is that the smallest dScMgBase_c-derived allocation in ov006 is dScMgSlot1_c at 0x4710, so sizeof(dScMgBase_c) <= 0x4710.
